shared_elements: horizontal linear bands dividing the field
limbs rendered as simple bent strips
justification: Both surfaces show highly schematic figures with stick-like bent limbs set against horizontal dividing lines, and both include rounded/circular forms, but these are generic conventions any schematic tradition could reach independently. A shows a single isolated human-like figure whose head is a set of concentric rings, crossed by long straight lines, whereas B is a densely populated register-based composition of a row of quadrupeds above, birds, a snake-like/plant motif and other creatures — no shared specific motif or relationship.
